welcome.title: Welcome to SportyExpats! 🎉
welcome.message: You're all set! Start exploring events, meet new people, and get active.

push.title: Welcome to SportyExpats!
push.body: Start exploring events and get active near you.

email.subject: Welcome to SportyExpats - Let's Get Moving!
email.intro: We're thrilled to have you join SportyExpats - the community where expats find their sporting tribe. Whether you're into football, volleyball, tennis, or something in between, there's a game waiting for you.
email.footer: If you have questions, feel free to reach out to our support team. We're here to help.

email.details: If this was you, no action is needed. If you did not initiate this login, we strongly recommend securing your account right away.
email.warning: If you didn't recognize this activity, change your password immediately and contact our support team.
email.footer: This is an automated security alert from SportyExpats.
